landing.hero: Self-declare your imports, without a broker
landing.sub: Hand-held from eCustoms access to release: AI prepares, you confirm. Penalty and red-corridor risk shown in GEL before the goods arrive.
landing.pillar1d: eCustoms access wizard (rs.ge service p=84), pre-arrival workflow, field-by-field sheet and XML.
landing.pillar2d: Underpayment from incorrect data is fined 100%, 200% on repeat (Customs Code art.167). Risk is shown in GEL per line.
landing.pillar3d: Prices compared with your own 90-day history. On deviation the app prepares an evidence package in advance.
landing.pillar4d: 100–150 GEL per declaration stays with you. You are the declarant; the app never submits and never stores eCustoms passwords.
landing.copilot: Co-pilot, not autopilot: every HS code and every calculation is confirmed by a human. Nothing is submitted to customs automatically.
landing.trust3: XML export in every paid plan

pricing.compareNote: DECLARO Pro 59 GEL / Max 236 GEL (incl. VAT), XML only in Max; a broker charges 100–150 GEL per declaration.
pricing.faq1q: Do you submit the declaration for me?
pricing.faq1a: No. The app prepares the data, the field-by-field sheet and the XML. You are the declarant and enter it in eCustoms yourself. Nothing is submitted to customs automatically.
pricing.faq2q: Do you store my eCustoms password?
pricing.faq2a: No. We never ask for it and never store it. The app only records your access status and expiry date.
pricing.faq3q: What is the XML and why do I need it?
pricing.faq3a: The XML is a ready-made declaration file you can import into eCustoms. It cuts manual entry time and the risk of typing errors.
pricing.faq4q: Does the price depend on the number of HS codes?
pricing.faq4a: No. A declaration costs the same however many HS codes it contains.
pricing.faq5q: Who confirms the HS code and the calculation?
pricing.faq5a: A human confirms every HS code and every calculation. The output of the app is an indicator, not a legal opinion.
pricing.faq6a: Prices are assumptions still being tested. Final prices will be announced before launch.
pricing.ctaSub: Go through the eCustoms access wizard and prepare your first declaration without paying anything.

terms.customsValue: Customs value — price up to the Georgian border: invoice + freight + insurance (CIF logic), in GEL at the NBG rate on registration day (art.8).
terms.cif: CIF — cost, insurance and freight to the destination port. Customs value follows this logic.
terms.incoterm: Incoterm — international rule on who pays transport/insurance and where risk passes. Determines what to add to the invoice.
terms.corridor: Corridor — eCustoms risk decision: green (release), blue, yellow (documents), red (inspection).
terms.assessment: Assessment number (A) — assigned by eCustoms at assessment. Without it the declaration is not complete.
terms.cez: CEZ — customs clearance zone where goods are cleared (Tbilisi 11111, Batumi 11112, Poti 11113, Airport 11114).
terms.preArrival: Pre-arrival declaration — lodged before arrival (≤45 days ahead). Fee 50/150/200 GEL and priority clearance.
terms.hs: HS code — 10-digit commodity code that determines duty, excise and required documents.
terms.penalty: Penalty (art.167) — 100% of the underpaid amount from incorrect data, 200% on repeat; natural person ≤3000 GEL: 40%/100%.
terms.advanceRuling: Advance ruling — official RS answer on the HS code that protects you from penalties. 30 days free.
terms.fee: Fee — state charge per declaration (Decree №96), customs value tiers ≤3000 / 3000–15000 / >15000 GEL.
